summary.zh: 把即时操作换成选点、等待与回收路线。
summary.en: Replace moment-to-moment fishing with placement, waiting and collection routes.

rules.zh: 玩家把捕捞装置放进水域，在离开期间积累渔获，再回来收取、补充或维修。装置数量与维护成本限制规模；收益取决于布点环境和回访频率。
rules.en: Deploy traps in water, leave them to catch and return to collect, refill or repair. Quantity and upkeep constrain scale; location and revisit frequency determine practical yield.

loop.zh: 布置装置并满足启动条件

decisions.zh: 高收益远点是否值得绕路，要按整条回收路线计算。
decisions.en: A distant rich spot must justify its place in the whole collection route.

decisions.zh: 放太多陷阱可能把休闲副业变成每日维护工作。
decisions.en: Too many traps can turn a casual side activity into an upkeep chore.

effect.zh: 低容量推动高频回访，高容量允许长途探索。
effect.en: Low capacity encourages frequent visits; high capacity permits longer expeditions.

effect.zh: 补饵消耗资源，维修制造停机，二者会形成不同节奏。
effect.en: Baiting consumes resources; repairs create downtime, producing different rhythms.

contrast.zh: 星露谷强调每日补饵循环；渔帆暗涌把布点与航线、耐久管理结合。
contrast.en: Stardew emphasizes daily rebaiting; DREDGE combines placement with sailing routes and durability.

combination.zh: 设计提案：捕捞装置还能测水质，玩家在收获与调查污染源之间设计巡回路线。
combination.en: Design proposal: traps also measure water quality, combining collection routes with pollution investigation.

setup.zh: 你有3个捕笼，远湾产量高，但一次往返要花很久。
setup.en: You have three traps; a distant bay yields well but takes a long round trip.

action.zh: 你把两个放在日常路线旁，一个放到远湾试产。
action.en: Place two along your daily route and one in the distant bay as a trial.

result.zh: 回访时得到渔获，也付出了路程与维护成本。
result.en: On returning, collect catches while paying travel and maintenance costs.

next.zh: 比较整趟收益后，把不划算的捕笼转移位置。
next.en: Compare total trip returns, then relocate traps that are not worth servicing.

firstStep.zh: 用地图上的3个点、固定往返时间和捕笼库存计时，测试布点与回收安排。
firstStep.en: Use three map points with travel costs and timed trap inventories to test placement and collection.

pitfall.zh: 过多强制日常维护会把自主规划变成打卡；先检查回访频率是否有弹性。
pitfall.en: Too many compulsory chores turn planning into attendance; test whether servicing schedules allow flexibility.

test.zh: 玩家是否按总路程重新分布捕笼，而不只盯着单个点的最高产量？
test.en: Do players relocate traps based on the whole route rather than the highest yield at one spot?
